description: Synthetic cassette conclusions consumed only by the zero-call replay harness; not an agent response schema.

questions.text: How reliably are synthetic orders delivered in the fixture?

analytical_owner.conclusion: The supplied fixture contains three bounded orders and supports only a fixture-level reliability summary.
analytical_owner.method: Inspect the bounded order table and run one deterministic summary script.

business_reviewer.conclusion: The answer addresses the fixture population and clearly limits interpretation.

integration.conclusion: Typed claim, metric, limitation, ontology, prepared-asset, and dashboard records were staged.

fidelity_reviewer.conclusion: Q-001 staged records faithfully represent its accepted fixture answer.

questions.text: Which synthetic process stage has the most observable delay?

analytical_owner.conclusion: The carrier handoff is the bounded stage requiring the clearest delay wording.
analytical_owner.method: Compare the three supplied stage observations without causal inference.

specialists.question: Check whether a stage comparison from three fixture rows can be stated as a causal delay.
specialists.conclusion: The comparison is descriptive only; the fixture has no causal timing design.
specialists.method: Inspect the supplied stage and amount fields and the question wording.

business_reviewer.problem: The initial wording is not explicit that the comparison is descriptive.
business_reviewer.evidence: The specialist memo confirms that three fixture rows do not support a causal delay claim.
business_reviewer.required_change: State that the carrier handoff is the largest observable fixture value, not a causal delay.

targeted_business_reviewer.second_problem: The repaired answer still needs an explicit unit and denominator statement.
targeted_business_reviewer.second_evidence: The current draft names the observable handoff but does not state the comparison unit.
targeted_business_reviewer.second_required_change: Add the comparison unit and denominator to the parent answer.
targeted_business_reviewer.conclusion: A fresh material answer issue requires one second bounded repair.

second_targeted_business_reviewer.conclusion: The second corrected answer states the descriptive unit and denominator and passes the final targeted recheck.

integration.conclusion: The corrected Q-002 answer was staged as typed integration records.

fidelity_reviewer.conclusion: Q-002 staged records match the repaired accepted answer.

questions.text: Which synthetic order is the next observable handoff risk?

analytical_owner.conclusion: O-002 is the bounded next handoff-risk observation, with no predictive claim.
analytical_owner.method: Combine a data-quality check with a business-context interpretation of the supplied fixture.

specialists.question: Check order identifier uniqueness and stage completeness.
specialists.conclusion: All three order IDs are unique and every stage value is populated.
specialists.method: Inspect the three bounded fixture rows.

specialists.question: Assess whether the largest supplied value can be described as predictive handoff risk.
specialists.conclusion: The result is an observable fixture risk flag, not a prediction.
specialists.method: Compare the question language with the available fields.
limitations: No outcome history or calibrated risk target.
open_questions: A real prediction would require historical outcomes.

business_reviewer.conclusion: The risk observation is supported and explicitly non-predictive.

integration.conclusion: The initial Q-003 dashboard fact and metric records were staged.

fidelity_reviewer.conclusion: One exact metric record needs a bounded label correction.

targeted_fidelity_reviewer.conclusion: The corrected Q-003 integration record passes targeted fidelity recheck.

role_conclusions.analytical_owner: One owner retains interpretation, calculation, synthesis, answer, and repair for every canned item.
role_conclusions.specialist: Optional specialists return bounded evidence memos and never own the parent answer.
role_conclusions.business_reviewer: Business review accepts Q-001/Q-003 and authorizes two bounded semantic Q-002 answer repairs with a final targeted acceptance.
role_conclusions.integration: One Result Integration owner stages typed records for each accepted item.
role_conclusions.fidelity_reviewer: Item-only fidelity accepts Q-001/Q-002 and authorizes one exact Q-003 record repair.
role_conclusions.product: The real offline dashboard renderer writes a traceable reviewed product fixture.
role_conclusions.optimizer: The real evidence collector reads frozen run-relative evidence and writes optimizer evidence only.
